intent: Individually teach stronger-support needs, grating into a bowl, eyes water, thin strips, sliced cucumber crunch, planted bean beside a window, a singular pea rolled off a plate and past golden corn.

workshop.title: 切形状、看变化，别补没说的结果
workshop.instruction: 调整形状与位置，比较因果和颜色变化，再把事实说完整。

transfer.stem: 换成豆苗、西葫芦和玉米粒，哪组三句保留了全部信息？
transfer.passage:
新观察与提示
豆苗需要更结实的支架。把西葫芦（courgette）擦成丝放进汤碗。一小粒玉米（a grain of corn）从碟子（saucer）上滚落，没有说明落点。

options.text: The bean plant needs a stronger stick. Grate the courgette into the soup bowl. A tiny grain of corn rolled off the saucer.
The bean plant already has a stronger stick. Grate the courgette into the soup bowl. A tiny grain of corn rolled off the saucer.
The bean plant needs a stronger stick. Grate the courgette beside the soup bowl. A tiny grain of corn rolled off the saucer.
The bean plant needs a stronger stick. Grate the courgette into the soup bowl. Two tiny grains of corn rolled off the saucer.

answer.display: The bean plant needs a stronger stick. Grate the courgette into the soup bowl. A tiny grain of corn rolled off the saucer.

steps.reason: a限定一粒；off保留离开碟子，不补落点。
